messages:
maya (PM): Quick sync: I'm proposing we formalize an Optimize Toolkit launch playbook that splits work into three deliverables: 1) batching + prefix caching advisor, 2) quantization recommendation + rollout guards, 3) eval-triggered alerting + mitigation templates. Need consensus on acceptance gates, pilot criteria, and what 'non-invasive' pilot looks like.
ci-bot: New doc: /docs/optimize/playbook-draft created by maya (PM) :page_facing_up:
derek (Eng): +1 to the 3 deliverables. For A (batch+cache) we should require: measurable batch-induced latency p95 delta <= 7% and cost unit reduction >=12% on targeted workloads. API sketch: `POST /v1/optimize/analyze` {"model":"...","sample_profile":"..."}. Response includes `suggested_batching`, `cache_placements`, `estimated_savings`.
samir (CS): From customers: they want a one-page "expected savings" PDF and an opt-in that doesn't change model semantics. Pilot asks: AcmeHealth needs private-only profiling and signed NDA for telemetry. LexiDocs wants a savings preview before enrolling. SummitChat wants minimum dev effort to opt in.
anika (SRE): Telemetry we need: batch_size_histogram, prefix_cache_hit_rate, kv_eviction_rate, end_to_end_p99, and request error rate. Canary proposal: 3% traffic for 24h, then 15% for 72h, then 50% for one week before full rollout. Auto-rollback triggers: p99 > +25% or error_rate > 0.4% sustained for 15m.
lee (Ops): For Private deployments, ensure the profiler runs only on-sample datasets and respects KMS/HSM keys. We'll need a local-only mode where data never leaves customer VPC.
derek (Eng): Implementation notes for B (quant recs): start with offline candidate generation + confidence score per layer. UI shows `recommended_profile` and `fallback_variant`. Runtime flags: `quant_profile=aggressive|balanced|safe` and `fallback_on_regression=true`. Provide `rio simulate --qprofile balanced --workload path.json` to estimate perf before applying.
maya (PM): Proposed acceptance criteria (draft): Wedge A: (i) 3 pilot orgs onboarded, (ii) documented SDK example + migration guide, (iii) median cost savings >=10% across pilots, (iv) no P0 regressions. Wedge B: (i) safe default profile with measurable perf gains, (ii) rollback plan validated in canary, (iii) offline scoring UI in Console. Wedge C: (i) 5 eval rule templates, (ii) alert routing to oncall + auto-suggested mitigations, (iii) onboarding runbook.
samir (CS): I'll start outreach to pilots and collect workload samples. Can we produce a lightweight savings-estimate tool for outreach? A single-run CLI or quick spreadsheet would be ideal.
derek (Eng): I'll aim to land a `rio estimate` MVP this sprint: takes model, sample workload, qprofile, and returns token/sec, mem delta, and cost estimate. Output: JSON + simple HTML report.
anika (SRE): We should gate pilots on having smoke harnesses: synthetic short/long mixes, token distribution, and failure injection. Retain detailed telemetry for 60 days for pilot, 365 days post-GA.
lee (Ops): Compliance: for customers needing data residency, plan S3-compatible local sinks and a toggle to disable telemetry export. Also add an audit event for each optimization applied.
maya (PM): Rough timeline proposal: 1) Wedge A: 5 weeks (including 1w buffer), 2) Wedge B: starts after A pilot results, 6 weeks, 3) Wedge C: parallel soft work during B, 4 weeks. Decision checkpoint next Tue.
derek (Eng): Risk note: batching gains are workload-dependent; we must avoid overpromising. Add a "no-regression" comparator in CLI that simulates baseline vs optimized.
samir (CS): For pilot comms, I want the one-pager template and an FAQ covering rollback and data handling. Maya, can you draft those this week?
maya (PM): Yes, I'll draft the pilot one-pager + FAQ and drop links in the doc. Putting decision deadline: Tue EOD. Tagging @derek @anika @samir for signoff. Thanks!
